; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Angle (mk-Angle (value Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Shape (mk-Shape (sides Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Triangle (mk-Triangle (sides Int)(a Ref)(b Ref)(c Ref)(base Int)(height Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((TAngle (mk-TAngle (value Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Equilateral (mk-Equilateral (sides Int)(a Ref)(b Ref)(c Ref)(base Int)(height Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Obtuse (mk-Obtuse (sides Int)(a Ref)(b Ref)(c Ref)(base Int)(height Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Angle (sel-Angle Angle))
  (lift-Shape (sel-Shape Shape))
  (lift-Triangle (sel-Triangle Triangle))
  (lift-TAngle (sel-TAngle TAngle))
  (lift-Equilateral (sel-Equilateral Equilateral))
  (lift-Obtuse (sel-Obtuse Obtuse))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Angle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Angle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Angle ((this Ref)) Angle
  (sel-Angle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Shape ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Shape (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Shape ((this Ref)) Shape
  (sel-Shape (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Triangle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Triangle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Triangle ((this Ref)) Triangle
  (sel-Triangle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-TAngle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TAngle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TAngle ((this Ref)) TAngle
  (sel-TAngle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Equilateral ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Equilateral (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Equilateral ((this Ref)) Equilateral
  (sel-Equilateral (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Obtuse ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Obtuse (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Obtuse ((this Ref)) Obtuse
  (sel-Obtuse (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Angle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Angle this)
    (deref-is-TAngle this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Shape ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Shape this)
    (deref-is-Triangle this)
    (deref-is-Equilateral this)
    (deref-is-Obtuse this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Triangle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-Triangle this)
    (deref-is-Equilateral this)
    (deref-is-Obtuse this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-TAngle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TAngle this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Equilateral ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Equilateral this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Obtuse ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Obtuse this)
)

; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Angle.value: ---

(define-fun Angle.value ((this Ref)) Int
  (ite (deref-is-Angle this) (value (deref-Angle this))
  (value (deref-TAngle this)))
)

(define-fun Angle!value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-Angle this))
)

; --- getters for Triangle.base: ---

(define-fun Triangle!base ((this Ref)) Int

; --- getters for Triangle.height: ---

(define-fun Triangle.height ((this Ref)) Int

(define-fun Triangle!height ((this Ref)) Int

; ================

; ================

; ----------------------------
;   Methods for class Angle:
; ----------------------------

(define-fun Angle.eq ((this Ref)(other Ref)) Bool
  (= (Angle.value this) (Angle.value other))
)

(define-fun Angle!eq ((this Ref)(other Ref)) Bool
  (= (Angle!value this) (Angle.value other))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Methods for class Shape:
; ----------------------------

(declare-fun Shape.area (Ref ) Real)

  (Shape.area this )
)

; -------------------------------
;   Methods for class Triangle:
; -------------------------------

(define-fun Triangle.area ((this Ref)) Real

)

(define-fun Triangle!area ((this Ref)) Real

(define-fun Angle.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool

(assert (! (Angle.inv1 2) :named _xkassert0))
